label: Resistance per square
subgoals: Divide the wire length by its width to count squares
Recognize that sheet resistance depends only on the layer
Keep length and width in the same unit before dividing

label: From resistivity to ohms
subgoals: Compute sheet resistance as resistivity over thickness
Count squares on each rectangle of the fractured wire
Add the resistance of segments that carry the same current in series

label: Corners and current crowding
subgoals: Separate the corner square from the straight arms
Count the corner square as 0.56 squares
Multiply the total square count by the sheet resistance
